xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">子智能体是主 Agent 可以在独立上下文中启动的专用 Agent，完成后会把结果汇总回主对话。ZCode 内置了 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">general-purpose（通用型）</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Explore</strong> 子智能体，现在你还可以在设置中创建自己的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户级子智能体</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">当主 Agent 判断任务需要独立上下文或并行调研时，会通过 Agent 工具启动子智能体。子智能体在自己的上下文中工作，并把结果汇总回主对话，帮助主 Agent 继续推进任务。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/subagent-parallel-20260701.webp" alt="主 Agent 并行委派代码审查、探索搜索、文档调研等子智能体，各自独立上下文并行执行" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="general-purpose">内置：通用型子智能体<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">general-purpose</strong> 是默认的通用型子智能体，拥有完整工具权限，适合在独立上下文中处理需要读取、修改、运行命令或综合推进的任务。主 Agent 可以在需要把一段工作拆出去并行推进时调用它。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">适合交给 general-purpose 的任务包括：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">独立实现一个小功能或修复一个明确问题。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在另一个上下文里整理文件、运行验证命令，并回传结果。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">把可并行的文档、代码或配置任务拆开处理。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果任务只需要只读调研、证据收集或调用链梳理，优先使用下面的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Explore</strong>。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="explore">内置：Explore<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Explore</strong> 是一个只读的文件搜索和代码库调研专家，适合处理大范围检索、调用链梳理、代码结构理解和证据收集这类探索任务。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Explore 子智能体只用于只读探索，不会创建、修改、移动或删除文件。它主要使用读取和搜索相关工具，例如读取文件、按文件名匹配、按正则搜索内容，以及在需要时读取已知 URL 或搜索外部信息。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">适合交给 Explore 的任务包括：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">查找某个能力在哪些文件中实现。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">梳理模块入口、调用链和关键依赖。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在改动前先调研相关代码和风险点。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">并行搜索多个目录、命名方式或实现路径。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">你可以直接在提示词里要求先做探索，例如：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">请先用 Explore 调研这个模块的调用链，再总结修改入口和风险点。
</code></pre>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">请用只读方式搜索这个功能的实现位置，列出相关文件和证据。
</code></pre>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="custom-subagents">自定义子智能体（Beta）<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Beta</strong> — 用户级自定义子智能体正在灰度上线，能力范围后续可能调整。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">现在你可以在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; 子智能体</strong> 中创建自己的子智能体。自定义子智能体可以把一个可复用的角色——例如代码审查员、测试编写者、文档调研员——连同它的模型、工具权限和指令一起打包，在不同任务中重复使用。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/subagent-list-20260701.webp" alt="子智能体设置页：内置的 general-purpose 与 Explore 角色" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在子智能体面板里，你可以：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">查看</strong> 可用的子智能体，包括内置的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">general-purpose</code>（默认角色，可用全部工具）和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Explore</code>（只读搜索）。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建</strong> 子智能体，填写名称、颜色、模型、思考强度、描述、可用工具和系统提示词。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">对你创建的子智能体进行 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">编辑</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">删除</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">启用</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">停用</strong>（内置角色不能编辑正文或删除，但可以为它们单独指定模型和思考强度）。</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="create-subagent">新建子智能体<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击右上角的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建</strong>，在表单中配置这个可复用角色：</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/subagent-create-20260701.webp" alt="新建子智能体表单：名称、颜色、模型、描述、可用工具与系统提示词" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">字段</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">名称</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">子智能体的标识，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">code-reviewer</code>。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">颜色标记</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">在列表和会话中区分该子智能体身份的颜色，仅作标识，不表达状态。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">可选「继承默认」（跟随主 Agent 当前模型），或指定一个具体模型。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">思考强度</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">为该子智能体单独设置推理档位，可选档位由所选模型决定。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅在指定了具体模型时生效</strong>：选择「继承默认」时子智能体完全跟随主 Agent 的推理配置，此项不参与。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">描述</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">展示给主 Agent 的简短说明。主 Agent 依据它判断何时调用该子智能体——描述越准确，越容易在合适的任务中被自动选用。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">可用工具</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">控制该子智能体能调用的工具范围。「默认所有权限」继承全部工具；「自定义可用工具」则逐个勾选（例如只给 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Read</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Grep</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Glob</code> 做只读审查，<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Bash</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Edit</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Write</code> 等可写工具会有标记提示）。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">系统提示词</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">描述这个子智能体的角色、边界和规则。</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">保存后，ZCode 会把子智能体写入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/agents/&lt;name&gt;.md</code> 这个 Markdown 文件，ZCode Agent 运行时会在下次运行时加载它。启用后，你可以让 Agent 自动选用该子智能体，也可以在聊天输入框中用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">@</code> 引用它。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="frontmatter-reference">定义文件字段参考<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">子智能体定义文件是带 frontmatter 的 Markdown，正文即系统提示词。除了表单里能配置的字段，手工编辑时还支持以下字段（camelCase，大小写敏感）：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">字段</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">name</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">description</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">必填，缺失时该定义文件会被忽略并产生诊断。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">model</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">指定具体模型；写 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">inherit</code> 或不填表示跟随主 Agent 当前模型。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">thoughtLevel</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">思考强度档位（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">high</code>）。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅在同时配置了具体 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">model</code> 时生效</strong>，档位必须是该模型支持的值。注意字段名不是 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">reasoningEffort</code>——不认识的字段会被静默忽略，不报错。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">color</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">颜色标记（预设色）。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tools</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">disallowedTools</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">可用 / 禁用工具列表，边界规则见下文<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#tools-and-mcp">工具与 MCP</a>。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">maxTurns</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">单次调用的最大轮数（正整数）。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">injectAgentsMd</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">是否注入 AGENTS.md，默认注入，见下文<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#agents-md">项目指令注入</a>。</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mcpServers</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">声明该子智能体依赖的 MCP 服务名列表（精确匹配）；声明的服务未连接时，调用会直接失败。</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">生效时机</strong>：修改定义文件、或在设置页调整子智能体的模型 / 思考强度后，需要<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建会话</strong>才会生效，已启动的会话不热更新。例外是切换主会话模型——未指定 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">model</code> 的子智能体在后续调用中会立即跟随新模型。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="tools-and-mcp">工具与 MCP<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">子智能体能用哪些工具，取决于「可用工具」（即 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tools</code> 字段）的配置方式：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">默认所有权限</strong>（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tools</code> 留空或 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">*</code>）：继承主会话的全部工具，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">包括已连接的 MCP 工具</strong>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自定义可用工具</strong>：列表里写了什么就只有什么。设置页的勾选列表只包含内置工具（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Read</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Grep</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Glob</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Bash</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Edit</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Write</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">WebFetch</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">WebSearch</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">TodoWrite</code>），因此勾选自定义后 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP 工具会全部不可用</strong>——内置的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">WebSearch</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">WebFetch</code> 不是 MCP 工具，不受影响。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">确需在自定义列表中保留个别 MCP 工具，可以手工编辑定义文件，把工具<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">全名</strong>逐个写进 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tools</code>，格式为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mcp__&lt;服务名&gt;__&lt;工具名&gt;</code>。通配写法（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mcp__server__*</code>）无效，会被静默忽略。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">另外两条边界：子智能体只能看到主会话<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">启动时</strong>已连接的 MCP 服务，会话中途新连接的服务对子智能体不可见（新建会话即可）；子智能体内不能再派发子智能体。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="agents-md">项目指令（AGENTS.md）注入<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">自 v3.7.1 起，子智能体默认注入用户级 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/AGENTS.md</code> 与工作区 AGENTS.md，与主 Agent 保持一致；在 frontmatter 中设置 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">injectAgentsMd: false</code> 可关闭。内置的 Explore 默认不注入。v3.7.1 之前的版本，子智能体不注入 AGENTS.md。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="custom-subagents-scope">范围与限制<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅限用户级。</strong> 当前 Beta 管理的是 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">全局 / 用户级</strong> 子智能体，存放在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/agents/</code>。暂不支持在设置中创建或编辑 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区 / 项目级</strong> 子智能体。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">内置角色不可删除或停用。</strong> <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">general-purpose</code> 和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Explore</code> 不能编辑正文、删除或停用，名称也不能被复用；但可以在设置页为它们单独指定模型和思考强度。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">后台执行由 Agent 自己决定。</strong> 你不需要手动切换，也没有单独的后台管理界面，详见下文 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#background">前台与后台执行</a>。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="background">前台与后台执行<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">子智能体有两种执行方式：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">前台执行</strong>：同时启动多个时并行跑，主任务等它们全部完成后再继续。适合结果马上就要用上的调研。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">后台执行</strong>：主任务不必等待，可以继续推进甚至先结束当前回合。无论结果如何，跑完后都会自动回到主对话，由 Agent 接手继续处理。适合耗时较长、又不该打断当前思路的调研。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">出于安全考虑，后台运行的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Explore</code> 子智能体 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只有只读工具</strong>（读取文件、按文件名查找、按内容搜索），不能修改任何东西。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">除了子智能体，终端命令同样可以后台执行，详见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/ADE-tools">智能体开发环境工具</a>。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
